summary: Plan r1 committed (AnsibleSpecs 5f0d7b8): cross-cutting task shape; eleven phases, in order: kaniko2 (JenkinsPipelineUtils), the tunnel-reclaim pin (KubeCoderDeploy), the relay pin (ArgoCDDeploy), registry-cleanup, version-poller and the matrix/pin-stage go-live with Keycloak's per-build pin (DockerImages), the dry-run unsuspension and Operator Action card (RegistryDeploy), the design doc, D53, and two deploy-repo comment sweeps; 19 verification criteria covering R1-R5 and D1-D3. P7's Target ../RegistryDeploy resolves only after the operator adds RegistryDeploy to .kubecoder/config.yaml and runs kc env restart (close-out A1); every other Target resolves under --dry-run.
